newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis sees 1996 profit more than cost.
newsitem.headline: Novartis sees 1996 profit more than cost.

text.p: Novartis AG merger partners Ciba-Geigy AG and Sandoz AG will post a combined profit of about four billion Swiss francs in 1996 before merger costs of two billion, designated chief financial officer Raymund Breu said.
"We will not have losses in 1996," Breu, currently chief financial officer at Sandoz, told a news conference.
Breu said merger costs in 1996 would total two billion, after after-tax charges of 3.5 billion are offset by divestment profits of 1.5 billion.

"You can calculate that the profits of Novartis will be around four billion Swiss francs in 1996 and so far this burden of two billion Swiss francs is something which doesn't weigh too heavily," Breu said.
